standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2 split entries: packet entries 'Aqua (Water' (raw 1) and 'Eau)' (raw 2) merged into one entry 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' @1; every later normalized position = raw position - 1; 32 normalized entries. All positions below are normalized.

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C1 (settled core): defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (ether type) with prominent amphoteric buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3 and no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signal: refatter PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @5.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by C2: early (prominent) silicone Dimethicone @8, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @13, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @16, deliberate humectant Panthenol @7; plus Amodimethicone @12, Hydrolyzed Keratin @6, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @5. Counter-signal: only the silicone (and keratin, panthenol) is prominent; guar and glycol distearate sit after Parfum @10, so the system may be lighter than the Wella-type C2 precedent; neighbor moderate.

nonMaterial: Hydrogenated Castor Oil @15 (waxy; after the W-line)
Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil @21 (after the W-line)

reset: strong anionic ether Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2

wLineRecord.note: Panthenol @7: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 before it; (ii) only Dimethicone @8 and Sodium Benzoate @9 between it and the cap. Both payload lipids (@15, @21) are after the W-line, so non-material (they were also after the E3 point under v1.6).

weightPotential.counterevidence: Dimethicone is prominent (@8) and joined by amodimethicone @12, guar @13 and hydrolyzed keratin @6; a waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @15 is present but after the W-line.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W1 shape: C1 sulfate chassis with a prominent betaine buffer (moderate cleansing), deposition = silicone + cationic guar + late amodimethicone, no material payload_lipid, no second cationic polymer, no film former. Whether or not Hydrolyzed Keratin @6 is read as a reinforcing protein film (which would end W1, 6.7 (c)), the full method gives the same result: plausible, bounded silicone/polymer residue that an effective SLES/betaine chassis (resetCapacity moderate) partly offsets.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high would need W-RICH (no material payload_lipid: Hydrogenated Castor Oil @15 and Apricot Kernel Oil @21 are listed after the W-line @7) or converging persistent systems that an effective sulfate chassis does not offset; the holdout-v3 W1 precedent sets this set at moderate. low is excluded because a prominent dimethicone plus guar and amodimethicone is a plausible depositing system (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-LINE item 6: the post-line waxy lipid @15 is part of what keeps the band from high, so confidence is at most moderate with neighbor high; W1 condition (c) ambiguity on hydrolyzed keratin.
weightPotential.rationale: moderate: W1-type silicone/guar/amodimethicone set in an effective C1 chassis, no material lipid (W-LINE); confidence moderate, neighbor high (W-LINE item 6).

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; keratin plus silicone/amino-silicone deposition is a coherent substantive cluster; moisture cluster is thin (no glycerin)

focusPrimary.counterSignal: only one protein; silicones also serve generic smoothing/shine
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; formula repair_supported; provisional general until a repair claim is seen.
focusPrimary.rationale: provisional general (formula-only); repair is the formula-compatible neighbor.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible. A shine claim via the same silicone route would not add shine (F2).

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular; frequent possible with U2 wording (cleansing moderate, not strong); no dandruff active.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted (no positioning visible). CSA met: prominent comfort/humectant route Panthenol @7 and refatting PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @5.

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: complete formula without a recognized dandruff active.

surfactantClasses.c4: defining anionic SLES @2; buffer CAPB @3; no reinforcing route

uncertainties: W1 condition (c): Hydrolyzed Keratin @6 could be read as a protein film reinforcing the set (W1 then does not apply); the full method gives moderate either way.
conditioningLevel high via C2 counts guar @13 and glycol distearate @16 although both are after the E3 point (C2 requires only the silicone to be early); alternative moderate.
